terminal_growth.name: terminal_growth
terminal_growth.rationale: Below long-run nominal GDP growth, per the g<3% constraint enforced by the engine.

risk_free_rate.name: risk_free_rate
risk_free_rate.rationale: 10Y matches the USD denomination and the 10-year explicit forecast horizon.

equity_risk_premium.name: equity_risk_premium
equity_risk_premium.source: Aswath Damodaran - Implied Equity Risk Premium, United States
equity_risk_premium.rationale: MATURE-MARKET ERP ONLY; country risk is added separately, so a country-weighted ERP here would double count. KNOWN MISMATCH: this is the January 2026 reading paired with an August 2026 risk-free rate. Damodaran recomputes the implied ERP from the prevailing risk-free rate each month, so the two inputs describe different market states. Replace with the latest monthly publication.

unlevered_industry_beta.name: unlevered_industry_beta
unlevered_industry_beta.source: Aswath Damodaran - US Industry Betas, Business & Consumer Services, unlevered beta corrected for cash
unlevered_industry_beta.rationale: Bottom-up industry beta rather than Uber's single-stock regression beta. Business & Consumer Services is a better economic proxy for a platform-based mobility and delivery marketplace than asset-heavy Transportation. Damodaran reports 0.77 unlevered, 0.81 corrected for cash. The engine relevers via Hamada. The industry choice is itself the judgement here: a Software (Internet) or Transportation classification would produce a materially different beta.

debt_spread.name: debt_spread
debt_spread.source: Aswath Damodaran - Ratings, Interest Coverage Ratios and Default Spread
debt_spread.rationale: Spread over the risk-free rate, not the full yield; the engine computes (risk_free + spread). Damodaran's January 2026 spread for Baa2/BBB large non-financial service firms is 1.11%. Uber is rated BBB+ by S&P but the table has no BBB+ bucket, so BBB is used as a conservative and reproducible proxy: a wider spread raises WACC and lowers value.

country_risk_premium.name: country_risk_premium
country_risk_premium.source: analyst judgment, weighted on Uber FY2024 Note 13 geographic revenue
country_risk_premium.rationale: ASSUMED ZERO, WHICH IS A DIRECTIONAL ASSUMPTION, NOT A NEUTRAL ONE. FY2024 revenue by geography: US 21,429 (48%), UK 8,373 (19%), all other countries 14,176 (32%). US and UK are mature markets carrying no country premium by convention, so the weight in question is the disclosed 32% and only the premium of that bucket is unobservable. Setting CRP to zero asserts that the undisaggregated bucket carries US-level risk, which almost certainly understates cost of equity and therefore overstates value. The arithmetic frame for a non-zero base case is CRP = 0.32 x assumed bucket premium. Revisit before treating any output as a valuation.

share_price.name: share_price
share_price.rationale: Closing price on August 27, 2026, for market-value capital structure. Shares an as_of with the risk-free rate to within one trading day.

discount_rate.name: discount_rate
discount_rate.rationale: NOT A VALUATION INPUT. Round-number rate proving the pipeline runs end to end. Superseded the moment build_wacc is wired into run_valuation.
